prompt: How many letters long is the title of the first movie composed by the composer of the first American Godzilla movie?
answer:
The composer was **Akira Ifukube**, whose first film score was **_Snow Trail_** (1947).

**“Snow Trail” has 9 letters** (excluding the space).
